title: Photo: Damascus Gate, Jerusalem, Israel (2016)
summary: Photograph of the Damascus Gate in the Old City walls of Jerusalem, taken in 2016, with people walking down the stone steps of the plaza in front of the gate.

pictures.description: Daytime photo of the Damascus Gate: a massive pale limestone city gate with crenellated battlements, two flanking towers and a central arched entrance, under a cloudy sky. People walk across the stepped stone plaza and railings in front of the gate.
